name: flash-agents
description: Delegate narrow tasks to cheap DeepSeek Harness workers. Each writing call runs in a disposable copy of your repository and returns a patch, so nothing reaches your tree until you apply it.

model.title: Worker model
model.description: Any model the local Ollama serves. The default is the one this project is tuned for; smaller local models are weaker at tool calling.

slots.title: Disposable copies in flight
slots.description: How many worker copies of your repository may exist at once. Each one is a separate harness process, so this is a memory decision.

isolate.title: Isolation
isolate.description: "copy" runs every writing call in a disposable copy and returns a patch. "none" lets workers write to your repository directly, and leaves the deterministic wall as the only defence.

state_dir.title: State directory
state_dir.description: Where worker copies and returned patches live. Leave empty for a private directory under the system temp area; set it to a fixed path to make worker session history browsable.
